description: Angular component for configuring time window settings in the Thingsboard UI, including form handling, validation, and popover interactions.

classes.name: TimewindowConfigDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for a dialog to configure time window settings, including form initialization, validation, and interaction handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form and subscribes to form control value changes for dynamic validation and UI updates.

methods.name: ngOnDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up subscriptions to prevent memory leaks.

methods.name: updateDisableAdvancedOptionState
methods.description: Enables or disables specific form controls based on interval visibility.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Adjusts validators for the aggregation limit based on the selected aggregation type.

methods.name: onTimewindowTypeChange
methods.description: Handles changes when switching between real-time and historical time window types.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merges form data into the timewindow object, cleans up properties, and closes the dialog with the updated data.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog without saving changes.

methods.name: currentRealtimeTimewindow
methods.description: Calculates the current realtime time window value from the form.

methods.name: currentHistoryTimewindow
methods.description: Calculates the current history time window value from the form.

methods.name: openAggregationOptionsConfig
methods.description: Opens a popover for configuring allowed aggregation types.

methods.name: configureRealtimeLastIntervalOptions
methods.description: Opens a popover to configure allowed last intervals for realtime.

methods.name: configureRealtimeQuickIntervalOptions
methods.description: Opens a popover to configure allowed quick intervals for realtime.

methods.name: configureHistoryLastIntervalOptions
methods.description: Opens a popover to configure allowed last intervals for history.

methods.name: configureHistoryQuickIntervalOptions
methods.description: Opens a popover to configure allowed quick intervals for history.

methods.name: openIntervalOptionsConfig
methods.description: Opens a popover to configure interval options for either realtime or history.
